thread:
sam_sales: FinServeCo POC kickoff. Customer asks: 30-day trial, ~10k queries/day, bursts to 400-500 rps. Hard asks: KMS-managed keys and SOC2 artifacts. Cost cap requested: <$1k. Need runbook, perf plan, and reserved vs PAYG pricing delta. Who can take point?

violet_se: I can own the runbook + env setup. Quick Q: is VPC mandatory day 1? They said preferred, but may accept hosted with CMK for initial run. Confirming with them.

omar_ml: Proposed model plan: start on redwood-lite-4q for latency, route ~10% to redwood-core for quality checks. Eval metrics: relevance >=91%, extraction F1 >=85%. Load test plan: warm 50 rps 10m, steady 225 rps 30m, peak 450 rps 10m. Capture p50/p95/p99 and cache hit rate.

mike_prod: Draft acceptance gates: 1) Quality: relevance & F1 thresholds; 2) Perf: p50<=130ms, p95<=380ms under profile; 3) Cost: <=$1k for 30 days; 4) Security: CMK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, data retention doc. If any gate fails, list mitigations.

security_bot: Logged security asks: SOC2 Type II, KMS integration doc, network/VPC peering steps, and data retention/deletion statement. Refer to https://internal.docs.redwood/security/presales.

sam_sales: Pricing note from customer: wants committed vs PAYG comparison. Can infra/billing provide a quick delta?

violet_se: I'll include an infra sizing appendix in the runbook and a curl smoke test. Expect env ready by Thu, load tests Fri.

omar_ml: I'll ship the eval harness and cost sim (based on prompt-length buckets). If p95 exceeds 380ms, fallback plan: increase batching window, enable quantized exec, or route more to redwood-core.

sam_sales: Great. I'll get NDA and sample data. Flag blockers here (quotas/legal/billing). :thumbsup:
